notes: OpenSPP is built on Odoo 17, which has native webhook support via the Automation Rules engine (`base_automation`). An OpenSPP admin creates an Automation Rule (Settings → Technical → Automation → Automation Rules), selects the target model, a trigger (record created / updated / stage set to), and a `Send Webhook Notification` action with the OpenFn URL. The payload includes `_model`, `_name`, `_id` and the selected fields. Webhook payloads are flat (no related-record traversal) — for enriched data, treat the webhook as a notification and call the REST API back to fetch full details (hybrid pattern). Polling via the FastAPI modules (`spp_api`, `g2p_registry_rest_api`, `g2p_programs_rest_api`) using `create_date` / `write_date` is the fallback.

triggers.name: New Registrant Created
triggers.description: Fires when a new registrant (individual or group) is created in OpenSPP. Configure an Odoo Automation Rule on the `g2p.registrant` (or `res.partner` with `is_registrant=True`) model with trigger `On Creation` and action `Send Webhook Notification` pointing to OpenFn. The webhook payload covers selected fields only — call back to the REST API for enriched data including group membership.
triggers.mechanismDetail: Manual webhook (Odoo 17 Automation Rule → Send Webhook Notification)

triggers.name: Registrant Updated
triggers.description: Fires when a registrant record is updated. Automation Rule with trigger `On Update` on `g2p.registrant`; can be filtered to specific field changes (e.g. address, phone). Also achievable via polling by `write_date`.

triggers.name: New Group Registered
triggers.description: Fires when a new household / family group is created. Automation Rule with trigger `On Creation` on `g2p.group` (or `res.partner` with `is_group=True`).

triggers.name: Enrollment Approved
triggers.description: Fires when a beneficiary enrollment is approved in a program cycle. Automation Rule with trigger `Stage is set to` (approved state) on the program membership model.

triggers.name: Enrollment Rejected
triggers.description: Fires when an enrollment application is rejected. Same Automation Rule pattern as Enrollment Approved with the rejected stage.

triggers.name: Payment Completed
triggers.description: Fires when a payment to a beneficiary is marked complete. Depends on which payment manager module is in use — if the payment status lives on an Odoo model field, an Automation Rule on that field change works. Fallback: poll payment records by status and `write_date`.

triggers.name: New Program Created
triggers.description: Fires when a new social protection program is created. Automation Rule with trigger `On Creation` on `g2p.program`.

triggers.name: Cycle Status Changed
triggers.description: Fires when a program cycle transitions to a target status (draft → approved → distributed → completed). Automation Rule with trigger `Stage is set to` on the cycle model.

triggers.name: Eligibility Assessed
triggers.description: Fires when an eligibility manager finishes assessing a beneficiary. If the result is written to a field, an Automation Rule on that change can fire. Eligibility often runs as a batch process — fallback is to poll beneficiary records via REST API.

triggers.name: New Entitlement Created
triggers.description: Fires when a new entitlement is generated for a beneficiary. Automation Rule with trigger `On Creation` on the entitlement model.

triggers.name: Change Request Submitted
triggers.description: Fires when a beneficiary submits a change request (address change, household composition update, etc.). Automation Rule with trigger `On Creation` on `spp.change.request`.

triggers.name: Grievance Filed
triggers.description: Fires when a new grievance is filed in the GRM (Grievance Redress Mechanism) module. Automation Rule with trigger `On Creation` on the GRM ticket model.
